topics.name: AI
topics.description: AI model capabilities, assistants, training, evaluation, and AI products. A coding tutorial that simply uses an AI tool belongs in Software & Web.

topics.name: Software & Web
topics.description: Programming, software engineering, developer tools, web design, accessibility, and web standards. Systems administration belongs in Self-Hosting & Systems.

topics.name: Security & Privacy
topics.description: Vulnerabilities, threats, defensive engineering, and privacy. A Linux story focused on a vulnerability belongs here even when it discusses systems administration.

topics.name: Self-Hosting & Systems
topics.description: Running services, infrastructure, storage and operating systems. A guide to running a Linux server belongs here when security is a supporting topic.

topics.name: Hardware & Devices
topics.description: Computers, chips, phones, wearables, accessories, component reviews, and device defects. Cameras primarily discussed as creative tools belong in Photography & Visual Arts.

topics.name: Internet & Tech Business
topics.description: Technology companies and their strategy, platforms, the indie web, online communities and publishing services. Use Software & Web for how a site is built.

topics.name: Gaming
topics.description: Games, gameplay, game development, emulation and consoles as gameplay platforms. A manufacturing defect on a console belongs in Hardware & Devices.

topics.name: Photography & Visual Arts
topics.description: Photography, editing, cameras used as creative tools, illustration, and visual arts. Audio, movies, and general pop culture belong in Books, Film & Music.

topics.name: Books, Film & Music
topics.description: Literature, book criticism, cinema, television, recorded music, and performing arts. A programming book discussed primarily for its technical teachings belongs in Software & Web.

topics.name: Life & Society
topics.description: Everyday life, personal essays, wellbeing, travel, public affairs, social issues, and ideas. Use a more specific topic when a specialized subject drives the article.
